purpose: Maintain a dependency-ordered queue of bounded architecture and learning experiments that may run between developmental training campaigns.
shared_invariants: freeze parent artifact, code revision, configuration, ordered material, seeds, optimizer state, precision, and hardware before execution
use behavior and mechanistic evidence as outcomes; retain loss as telemetry unless a narrow loss hypothesis is preregistered
report matched-experience results first and also report parameters, compute, latency, wall time, and peak VRAM
do not convert an observer into a learning rule or a prepared plan into an authorized campaign

experiments.title: Inference-depth characterization
experiments.question: Does additional ordinary shared-weight BDH computation improve, plateau, oscillate, or degrade behavior?
experiments.design: Evaluate one immutable checkpoint over a frozen compute-tick sweep with competence and multi-step diagnostic strata.
experiments.advance_when: A repeatable diagnostic gain survives controls without material competence regression or instability.

experiments.title: Latent-interface transparency
experiments.question: Can detachable thought-loop and controller interfaces be disabled with baseline-equivalent behavior?
experiments.design: Compare preserved BDH with the new interfaces disabled, including logits, hidden states, gradients, learned and optimizer leaves, RNG use, save/load, and state reset.
experiments.advance_when: The disabled path is exact or every non-behavioral serialization difference is exhaustively explained.

experiments.title: Contrastive gate-credit replication
experiments.question: Does local gate credit contain repeatable structure tied to concept, phase, contrast, acquisition, or retention?
experiments.design: Repeat the proven transparent observer on a preregistered contrastive lesson pack with held-out variants and random-label, shuffled-phase, and matched-scale controls.
required_controls: local rather than globally cancelled metrics
experiments.advance_when: A preregistered local pattern replicates, survives controls, and relates plausibly to behavior.

experiments.title: Fixed-depth external latent loopback
experiments.question: Can an external context-preserving latent loop improve diagnostic behavior at forced depths?
experiments.design: Compare identity, gated, and context-preserving loopback candidates against ordinary recurrence and parameter/compute-matched non-recurrent sidecars.
required_controls: original context separated from evolving thought
experiments.advance_when: A stable loopback beats both ordinary recurrence and the matched sidecar while retaining grounded context.

experiments.title: Passive adversarial checker
experiments.question: Can a separate checker detect calibrated contradictions, unsupported claims, binding errors, and unmet constraints without controlling output?
experiments.design: Broca silently renders one cached candidate. The checker inspects that candidate and grounded evidence passively; it cannot delay, veto, rewrite, or return a thought.
experiments.advance_when: Selected concern families generalize and retain a low false-challenge rate on difficult correct material.

experiments.title: One-shot adversarial challenge
experiments.question: Does one checker-triggered reconsideration improve output beyond equally expensive unconditional or random extra computation?
experiments.design: Pass emits the exact cached Broca candidate. Challenge discards its language and loops only grounded context, latent tokens, and a nonlinguistic RECONSIDER signal once; the second candidate must pass.
experiments.advance_when: Selective challenge beats frequency- and compute-matched controls with bounded damage to initially correct answers.

experiments.title: Recurrence by causal activation-history factorial
experiments.question: Are repeated computation and causal within-forward activation history independently useful or interactive?
experiments.design: Train a strict 2x2 with recurrence on/off and activation history on/off, spelling out all knobs so attention decay is not an accidental confound.
required_controls: multiple seeds for any architectural conclusion
experiments.advance_when: A main effect or interaction replicates without protected-capability loss or instability.

experiments.title: Main-controlled supervised routing
experiments.question: Can Ninereeds-main learn whether another latent pass is useful from counterfactual forced-depth trajectories?
experiments.design: Train EXPRESS/LOOP targets from marginal answer utility at each depth and compare with fixed-depth and checker-controlled policies.
experiments.advance_when: The learned policy improves the held-out quality/compute frontier without harmful premature expression.

experiments.title: Metacognitive effort allocation
experiments.question: Can Ninereeds-main select an initial compute budget and revise it upward once without maximum-effort collapse or underthinking?
experiments.design: Compare route-only, fixed-depth, effort-without-reevaluation, effort-with-one-reevaluation, maximum, and random policies under an immutable harness ceiling.
experiments.advance_when: Autonomous effort improves the quality/compute frontier and reevaluation has demonstrated causal utility.

experiments.title: Shadow local-rule evaluation
experiments.question: Can a narrowly defined local candidate update predict useful credit better than magnitude-matched local controls?
experiments.design: Compute, log, and discard a parameter-shaped candidate rule without applying it to parameters, state, optimizer, or checkpoints.
experiments.advance_when: The rule beats every local control on frozen held-out data and predicts meaningful behavior.

experiments.title: Oscillatory-binding sidecar
experiments.question: Does oscillatory binding improve grouping or variable binding beyond ordinary recurrence and matched added capacity?
experiments.design: Begin with synthetic binding tasks, then permit a small Ninereeds replication only after success against ordinary recurrence and a parameter/compute-matched non-oscillatory sidecar.
experiments.advance_when: A held-out advantage has a binding-linked mechanistic signature and survives matched controls.
